_comment: aterm VTE-ENGINE baseline: per scenario, the best sample's MiB per 10^9 performance-core cycles (cycles per instruction on P-cores times all instructions, from the kernel's per-core-type counters) of the pinned vtebench's default suite (payloads captured from its own scripts) and the arena's 150 MB d1 ascii and unicode corpora, replayed into Terminal::process at 120x40 in 16 KiB slices on a live session's engine. BIGGER-IS-BETTER; the lane runs unadmitted at the load it finds, which moves its ms per MiB on both clocks, so cycles are what is judged. Re-record with targo --unverified verify perf --record vte-engine.
